title: cs2pt Ni2In type, Karpov 2003 lattice
source: Cs2Pt, Ni2In type P6_3/mmc, experimental lattice a = 5.676, c = 9.471 A (Karpov, Nuss, Wedig, Jansen, Angew. Chem. Int. Ed. 42, 4818 (2003))
edits: Ni2In-type sites have no free coordinates: the fractional coordinates of mp-13548 (cases/cs2pt/v3) are kept and the lattice is set to the experimental a and c (c/a 1.669 instead of 1.360)
